barbarian||Rage.name: Rage
barbarian||Rage.summary: Bonus action to rage for 1 minute unless in heavy armor: advantage on Str checks/saves, bonus melee Str damage per Rage Damage column, resistance to bludgeoning/piercing/slashing. No spellcasting or concentration. Ends early if unconscious or no attack/damage since last turn.

barbarian||Unarmored Defense.name: Unarmored Defense
barbarian||Unarmored Defense.summary: With no armor worn, AC is 10 + Dex mod + Con mod; a shield may still be used.

barbarian||Reckless Attack.name: Reckless Attack
barbarian||Reckless Attack.summary: On your first attack of the turn, choose to gain advantage on Str-based melee weapon attacks this turn; attacks against you have advantage until your next turn.

barbarian||Danger Sense.name: Danger Sense
barbarian||Danger Sense.summary: Advantage on Dex saves against effects you can see (traps, spells), provided you are not blinded, deafened, or incapacitated.

barbarian||Primal Path.name: Primal Path
barbarian||Primal Path.summary: Pick a path (Berserker or Totem Warrior) that grants features at 3rd, 6th, 10th, and 14th level.

barbarian||Ability Score Improvement.name: Ability Score Improvement
barbarian||Ability Score Improvement.summary: At 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th, and 19th level, add +2 to one ability or +1 to two abilities, max 20.

barbarian||Extra Attack.name: Extra Attack
barbarian||Extra Attack.summary: Make two attacks instead of one when taking the Attack action.

barbarian||Fast Movement.name: Fast Movement
barbarian||Fast Movement.summary: +10 ft. walking speed while not in heavy armor.

barbarian||Feral Instinct.name: Feral Instinct
barbarian||Feral Instinct.summary: Advantage on initiative. If surprised and not incapacitated, you may act on your first turn as long as you rage before doing anything else.

barbarian||Brutal Critical.name: Brutal Critical
barbarian||Brutal Critical.summary: Roll one extra weapon damage die on melee critical hits; two extra dice at 13th level, three at 17th.

barbarian||Relentless Rage.name: Relentless Rage
barbarian||Relentless Rage.summary: When dropped to 0 HP while raging (not killed outright), DC 10 Con save to stay at 1 HP instead. DC rises by 5 per later use; resets on a short or long rest.

barbarian||Persistent Rage.name: Persistent Rage
barbarian||Persistent Rage.summary: Rage only ends early if you fall unconscious or choose to end it.

barbarian||Indomitable Might.name: Indomitable Might
barbarian||Indomitable Might.summary: If a Strength check total is below your Strength score, use the score instead.

barbarian||Primal Champion.name: Primal Champion
barbarian||Primal Champion.summary: Strength and Constitution each rise by 4, and their maximum becomes 24.

barbarian|berserker|Frenzy.name: Frenzy
barbarian|berserker|Frenzy.summary: When you rage you may frenzy: one melee weapon attack as a bonus action each turn after this one; gain one level of exhaustion when the rage ends.

barbarian|berserker|Mindless Rage.name: Mindless Rage
barbarian|berserker|Mindless Rage.summary: Immune to charmed and frightened while raging; such existing effects are suspended during the rage.

barbarian|berserker|Intimidating Presenc.name: Intimidating Presence
barbarian|berserker|Intimidating Presenc.summary: Action: one creature within 30 ft. that can see/hear you makes a Wis save (DC 8 + prof + Cha) or is frightened until end of your next turn; extend with your action each turn. Ends beyond 60 ft. or out of sight. On a success, that creature is immune for 24 hours.

barbarian|berserker|Retaliation.name: Retaliation
barbarian|berserker|Retaliation.summary: Reaction when a creature within 5 ft. damages you: make one melee weapon attack against it.

barbarian|totem-warrior|Spirit Seeker.name: Spirit Seeker
barbarian|totem-warrior|Spirit Seeker.summary: Can cast beast sense and speak with animals, but only as rituals.

barbarian|totem-warrior|Totem Spirit.name: Totem Spirit
barbarian|totem-warrior|Totem Spirit.summary: Choose a totem animal (Bear, Eagle, or Wolf) and gain its rage benefit; requires a physical totem object incorporating parts of that animal.

barbarian|totem-warrior|Aspect of the Be.name: Aspect of the Beast
barbarian|totem-warrior|Aspect of the Be.summary: Choose a totem animal (same or different) and gain its always-on benefit: Bear, Eagle, or Wolf.

barbarian|totem-warrior|Spirit Walker.name: Spirit Walker
barbarian|totem-warrior|Spirit Walker.summary: Can cast commune with nature, but only as a ritual; a spirit of one of your chosen totem animals delivers the information.

barbarian|totem-warrior|Totemic Attuneme.name: Totemic Attunement
barbarian|totem-warrior|Totemic Attuneme.summary: Choose a totem animal (same or different) and gain its rage benefit: Bear, Eagle, or Wolf.

barbarian|opt|Totem Spirit|Bear.name: Bear
barbarian|opt|Totem Spirit|Bear.summary: While raging, resistance to every damage type except psychic.

barbarian|opt|Totem Spirit|Eagle.name: Eagle
barbarian|opt|Totem Spirit|Eagle.summary: While raging and not in heavy armor, opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage and you can Dash as a bonus action.

barbarian|opt|Totem Spirit|Wolf.name: Wolf
barbarian|opt|Totem Spirit|Wolf.summary: While raging, allies have advantage on melee attacks against hostile creatures within 5 ft. of you.

barbarian|opt|Aspect of the Beast|Bear.name: Bear
barbarian|opt|Aspect of the Beast|Bear.summary: Carrying capacity (incl. max load and lift) doubled; advantage on Str checks to push, pull, lift, or break.

barbarian|opt|Aspect of the Beast|Eagle.name: Eagle
barbarian|opt|Aspect of the Beast|Eagle.summary: See up to 1 mile clearly, discerning fine detail as if within 100 ft.; dim light does not impose disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks.

barbarian|opt|Aspect of the Beast|Wolf.name: Wolf
barbarian|opt|Aspect of the Beast|Wolf.summary: Track creatures while traveling at a fast pace, and move stealthily at a normal pace.

barbarian|opt|Totemic Attunement|Bear.name: Bear
barbarian|opt|Totemic Attunement|Bear.summary: While raging, hostile creatures within 5 ft. have disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you or others with this feature (unless they can't see/hear you or can't be frightened).

barbarian|opt|Totemic Attunement|Eagle.name: Eagle
barbarian|opt|Totemic Attunement|Eagle.summary: While raging, gain a flying speed equal to walking speed, but you fall if you end your turn airborne with nothing holding you up.

barbarian|opt|Totemic Attunement|Wolf.name: Wolf
barbarian|opt|Totemic Attunement|Wolf.summary: While raging, when you hit a Large or smaller creature with a melee weapon attack, bonus action to knock it prone.

bard||Spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
bard||Spellcasting.summary: Known-spells Cha caster from the bard list (cantrips and spells known per table); swap one known spell on level-up; can ritual-cast known ritual spells; musical instrument as focus. Save DC 8 + prof + Cha.

bard||Bardic Inspiration.name: Bardic Inspiration
bard||Bardic Inspiration.summary: Bonus action: give a creature (not you) within 60 ft. that can hear you an inspiration die (d6, d8 at 5th, d10 at 10th, d12 at 15th) to add to one ability check, attack, or save within 10 minutes. One die per creature.

bard||Jack of All Trades.name: Jack of All Trades
bard||Jack of All Trades.summary: Add half proficiency bonus (rounded down) to any ability check that doesn't already use your proficiency bonus.

bard||Song of Rest.name: Song of Rest
bard||Song of Rest.summary: During a short rest, you and friendly listeners who spend Hit Dice regain extra 1d6 HP (1d8 at 9th, 1d10 at 13th, 1d12 at 17th).

bard||Bard College.name: Bard College
bard||Bard College.summary: Choose College of Lore or College of Valor, granting features at 3rd, 6th, and 14th level.

bard||Expertise.name: Expertise
bard||Expertise.summary: Double proficiency bonus for two chosen skill proficiencies; pick two more at 10th level.

bard||Ability Score Improvement.name: Ability Score Improvement
bard||Ability Score Improvement.summary: At 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th, and 19th level, add +2 to one ability or +1 to two abilities, max 20.

bard||Font of Inspiration.name: Font of Inspiration
bard||Font of Inspiration.summary: Bardic Inspiration uses now recover on a short or long rest.

bard||Countercharm.name: Countercharm
bard||Countercharm.summary: Action: perform until end of next turn; you and friendly creatures within 30 ft. that can hear you have advantage on saves against frightened and charmed. Ends if incapacitated, silenced, or you stop.

bard||Magical Secrets.name: Magical Secrets
bard||Magical Secrets.summary: Learn two spells of any class (of a level you can cast, or cantrips); they count as bard spells and toward Spells Known. Two more at 14th and 18th.

bard||Superior Inspiration.name: Superior Inspiration
bard||Superior Inspiration.summary: When you roll initiative with no Bardic Inspiration uses left, regain one use.

bard|lore|Bonus Proficiencies.name: Bonus Proficiencies
bard|lore|Bonus Proficiencies.summary: Gain proficiency in three skills of your choice.

bard|lore|Cutting Words.name: Cutting Words
bard|lore|Cutting Words.summary: Reaction: when a creature within 60 ft. you can see makes an attack roll, ability check, or damage roll, spend a Bardic Inspiration use and subtract the die from its roll. Creatures that can't hear you or can't be charmed are immune.

bard|lore|Additional Magical Secrets.name: Additional Magical Secrets
bard|lore|Additional Magical Secrets.summary: Learn two spells from any class (castable level or cantrip); they count as bard spells but not against Spells Known.

bard|lore|Peerless Skill.name: Peerless Skill
bard|lore|Peerless Skill.summary: Spend a Bardic Inspiration use to add the die to your own ability check, deciding after the roll but before the outcome is known.

bard|valor|Bonus Proficiencies.name: Bonus Proficiencies
bard|valor|Bonus Proficiencies.summary: Gain proficiency with medium armor, shields, and martial weapons.

bard|valor|Combat Inspiration.name: Combat Inspiration
bard|valor|Combat Inspiration.summary: A creature holding your Bardic Inspiration die may add it to a weapon damage roll it just made, or use its reaction to add it to AC against an attack after seeing the roll.

bard|valor|Extra Attack.name: Extra Attack
bard|valor|Extra Attack.summary: Make two attacks instead of one when taking the Attack action.

bard|valor|Battle Magic.name: Battle Magic
bard|valor|Battle Magic.summary: After using your action to cast a bard spell, make one weapon attack as a bonus action.

cleric||Spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
cleric||Spellcasting.summary: Full Wisdom caster that prepares spells daily from the whole cleric list (Wis mod + cleric level, min 1). Can ritual-cast prepared ritual spells; holy symbol works as focus.

cleric||Divine Domain.name: Divine Domain
cleric||Divine Domain.summary: Pick a domain tied to your deity (Knowledge, Life, Light, Nature, Tempest, Trickery, War). It grants features at 1st, 2nd (Channel Divinity option), 6th, 8th and 17th level.

cleric||Domain Spells.name: Domain Spells
cleric||Domain Spells.summary: Your domain adds two spells at cleric levels 1, 3, 5, 7 and 9. They are always prepared, don't count toward your prepared total, and count as cleric spells for you.

cleric||Channel Divinity.name: Channel Divinity
cleric||Channel Divinity.summary: Spend a use to create one divine effect: Turn Undead or your domain's option(s). Save DCs use your cleric spell save DC. Uses return on a short or long rest; 2 uses at 6th, 3 at 18th.

cleric||Channel Divinity: Turn Undead.name: Channel Divinity: Turn Undead
cleric||Channel Divinity: Turn Undead.summary: Action: undead within 30 ft. that see or hear you make a Wis save; on a failure each is turned for 1 minute or until damaged, fleeing you and unable to take reactions.

cleric||Ability Score Improvement.name: Ability Score Improvement
cleric||Ability Score Improvement.summary: At 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th and 19th level, add +2 to one ability or +1 to two abilities (max 20).

cleric||Destroy Undead.name: Destroy Undead
cleric||Destroy Undead.summary: Undead that fail the save against your Turn Undead are destroyed outright if their CR is at or below the threshold: 1/2 at 5th, 1 at 8th, 2 at 11th, 3 at 14th, 4 at 17th.

cleric||Divine Intervention.name: Divine Intervention
cleric||Divine Intervention.summary: Action: ask your god for help and roll d100; if the roll is no higher than your cleric level the DM grants aid. Success locks it for 7 days, failure until a long rest. Auto-succeeds at 20th.

cleric|life|Disciple of Life.name: Disciple of Life
cleric|life|Disciple of Life.summary: Healing spells of 1st level or higher restore an extra 2 + spell level hit points to each creature they heal.

cleric|life|Channel Divinity: Preserve L.name: Channel Divinity: Preserve Life
cleric|life|Channel Divinity: Preserve L.summary: Action: split 5 x cleric level hit points of healing among creatures within 30 ft., raising none above half its max HP. No effect on undead or constructs.

cleric|life|Blessed Healer.name: Blessed Healer
cleric|life|Blessed Healer.summary: When a 1st-level-or-higher spell of yours heals someone other than you, you also regain 2 + spell level hit points.

cleric|life|Divine Strike.name: Divine Strike
cleric|life|Divine Strike.summary: Once per turn on a weapon hit, add 1d8 radiant damage (2d8 from 14th level).

cleric|life|Supreme Healing.name: Supreme Healing
cleric|life|Supreme Healing.summary: Healing spell dice are not rolled; each die counts as its maximum value.

cleric|knowledge|Blessings of Knowledge.name: Blessings of Knowledge
cleric|knowledge|Blessings of Knowledge.summary: Learn two languages and gain proficiency in two of Arcana, History, Nature or Religion; your proficiency bonus is doubled for checks with those two skills.

cleric|knowledge|Channel Divinity: Knowl.name: Channel Divinity: Knowledge of the Ages
cleric|knowledge|Channel Divinity: Knowl.summary: Action: choose one skill or tool and be proficient with it for 10 minutes.

cleric|knowledge|Channel Divinity: Read.name: Channel Divinity: Read Thoughts
cleric|knowledge|Channel Divinity: Read.summary: Action: a creature within 60 ft. makes a Wis save. On a failure you read its surface thoughts for 1 minute and may end it to cast suggestion on it (no slot, auto-fail). If it saves, you can't retry this until a long rest.

cleric|knowledge|Potent Spellcasting.name: Potent Spellcasting
cleric|knowledge|Potent Spellcasting.summary: Add your Wisdom modifier to damage dealt by your cleric cantrips.

cleric|knowledge|Visions of the Past.name: Visions of the Past
cleric|knowledge|Visions of the Past.summary: Meditate (concentration, up to Wis-score minutes) to see past events: Object Reading reveals an item's previous owner(s); Area Reading reveals significant events nearby going back Wis-score days.

cleric|opt|Visions of the Past|Object Re.name: Object Reading
cleric|opt|Visions of the Past|Object Re.summary: After 1 minute holding an object, learn how its owner got and lost it and the latest notable event involving them; extra minutes reveal earlier recent owners.

cleric|opt|Visions of the Past|Area Read.name: Area Reading
cleric|opt|Visions of the Past|Area Read.summary: Each minute of meditation reveals one significant event in the surrounding area (up to a 50-ft. cube), newest first, going back up to Wis-score days.

cleric|light|Bonus Cantrip.name: Bonus Cantrip
cleric|light|Bonus Cantrip.summary: Learn the light cantrip if you don't already know it.

cleric|light|Warding Flare.name: Warding Flare
cleric|light|Warding Flare.summary: Reaction when a creature within 30 ft. you can see attacks you: impose disadvantage on that attack (creatures immune to blindness are unaffected).

cleric|light|Channel Divinity: Radiance.name: Channel Divinity: Radiance of the Dawn
cleric|light|Channel Divinity: Radiance.summary: Action: dispel magical darkness within 30 ft.; hostile creatures there make a Con save, taking 2d10 + cleric level radiant damage (half on success). Total cover protects.

cleric|light|Improved Flare.name: Improved Flare
cleric|light|Improved Flare.summary: Warding Flare can also protect another creature attacked within 30 ft. of you.

cleric|light|Potent Spellcasting.name: Potent Spellcasting
cleric|light|Potent Spellcasting.summary: Add your Wisdom modifier to damage dealt by your cleric cantrips.

cleric|light|Corona of Light.name: Corona of Light
cleric|light|Corona of Light.summary: Action: emit sunlight (60 ft. bright, 30 ft. more dim) for 1 minute; enemies in the bright light have disadvantage on saves against fire or radiant spells.

cleric|nature|Acolyte of Nature.name: Acolyte of Nature
cleric|nature|Acolyte of Nature.summary: Learn one druid cantrip and gain proficiency in Animal Handling, Nature or Survival (pick one).

cleric|nature|Channel Divinity: Charm An.name: Channel Divinity: Charm Animals and Plants
cleric|nature|Channel Divinity: Charm An.summary: Action: beasts and plant creatures within 30 ft. that see you make a Wis save or are charmed (friendly to you and allies) for 1 minute or until damaged.

cleric|nature|Dampen Elements.name: Dampen Elements
cleric|nature|Dampen Elements.summary: Reaction: give yourself or a creature within 30 ft. resistance against one instance of acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder damage.

cleric|nature|Divine Strike.name: Divine Strike
cleric|nature|Divine Strike.summary: Once per turn on a weapon hit, add 1d8 cold, fire or lightning damage (your pick); 2d8 from 14th level.

cleric|nature|Master of Nature.name: Master of Nature
cleric|nature|Master of Nature.summary: Bonus action: command creatures charmed by your Charm Animals and Plants what to do on their next turn.

cleric|tempest|Bonus Proficiencies.name: Bonus Proficiencies
cleric|tempest|Bonus Proficiencies.summary: Gain martial weapon and heavy armor proficiency.

cleric|tempest|Wrath of the Storm.name: Wrath of the Storm
cleric|tempest|Wrath of the Storm.summary: Reaction when a creature within 5 ft. that you can see hits you: it makes a Dex save, taking 2d8 lightning or thunder damage (half on success).

cleric|tempest|Channel Divinity: Destruc.name: Channel Divinity: Destructive Wrath
cleric|tempest|Channel Divinity: Destruc.summary: When you roll lightning or thunder damage, spend Channel Divinity to deal the maximum instead of rolling.

cleric|tempest|Thunderbolt Strike.name: Thunderbolt Strike
cleric|tempest|Thunderbolt Strike.summary: When you deal lightning damage to a Large or smaller creature, you can also push it up to 10 ft. away.

cleric|tempest|Divine Strike.name: Divine Strike
cleric|tempest|Divine Strike.summary: Once per turn on a weapon hit, add 1d8 thunder damage (2d8 from 14th level).

cleric|tempest|Stormborn.name: Stormborn
cleric|tempest|Stormborn.summary: Gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed while not underground or indoors.

cleric|trickery|Blessing of the Trickste.name: Blessing of the Trickster
cleric|trickery|Blessing of the Trickste.summary: Action: touch a willing creature other than you to give it advantage on Dex (Stealth) checks for 1 hour or until you use this again.

cleric|trickery|Channel Divinity: Invoke.name: Channel Divinity: Invoke Duplicity
cleric|trickery|Channel Divinity: Invoke.summary: Action: create an illusory double within 30 ft. for 1 minute (concentration). Bonus action moves it 30 ft. (stay within 120 ft.); you may cast spells from its space and gain advantage on attacks vs. creatures adjacent to both of you.

cleric|trickery|Channel Divinity: Cloak.name: Channel Divinity: Cloak of Shadows
cleric|trickery|Channel Divinity: Cloak.summary: Action: become invisible until the end of your next turn; attacking or casting a spell ends it.

cleric|trickery|Divine Strike.name: Divine Strike
cleric|trickery|Divine Strike.summary: Once per turn on a weapon hit, add 1d8 poison damage (2d8 from 14th level).

cleric|trickery|Improved Duplicity.name: Improved Duplicity
cleric|trickery|Improved Duplicity.summary: Invoke Duplicity creates up to four duplicates; one bonus action moves any of them up to 30 ft. each (within 120 ft.).

cleric|war|Bonus Proficiencies.name: Bonus Proficiencies
cleric|war|Bonus Proficiencies.summary: Gain martial weapon and heavy armor proficiency.

cleric|war|War Priest.name: War Priest
cleric|war|War Priest.summary: When you take the Attack action, you can make one extra weapon attack as a bonus action.

cleric|war|Channel Divinity: Guided Stri.name: Channel Divinity: Guided Strike
cleric|war|Channel Divinity: Guided Stri.summary: After seeing your attack roll but before the result is declared, spend Channel Divinity for +10 to that roll.

cleric|war|Channel Divinity: War God's B.name: Channel Divinity: War God's Blessing
cleric|war|Channel Divinity: War God's B.summary: Reaction: spend Channel Divinity to give +10 to an attack roll made by a creature within 30 ft. (decide after the roll, before the result).

cleric|war|Divine Strike.name: Divine Strike
cleric|war|Divine Strike.summary: Once per turn on a weapon hit, add 1d8 damage of the weapon's damage type (2d8 from 14th level).

cleric|war|Avatar of Battle.name: Avatar of Battle
cleric|war|Avatar of Battle.summary: Gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons.

druid||Druidic.name: Druidic
druid||Druidic.summary: You know the secret druid language and can leave hidden messages in it; others notice such a message with a DC 15 Wis (Perception) check but can't read it without magic.

druid||Spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
druid||Spellcasting.summary: Full Wisdom caster preparing Wis mod + druid level (min 1) spells daily from the druid list; ritual casting for prepared rituals; druidic focus as spellcasting focus.

druid||Wild Shape.name: Wild Shape
druid||Wild Shape.summary: Action: turn into a beast you have seen, for up to half your druid level in hours. Max CR 1/4 with no fly/swim speed at 2nd; CR 1/2, no fly at 4th; CR 1 at 8th. You take the beast's HP and stats but keep mental scores and can't cast spells.

druid||Druid Circle.name: Druid Circle
druid||Druid Circle.summary: Join the Circle of the Land or the Circle of the Moon; the circle grants features at 2nd, 6th, 10th and 14th level.

druid||Ability Score Improvement.name: Ability Score Improvement
druid||Ability Score Improvement.summary: At 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th and 19th level, add +2 to one ability or +1 to two abilities (max 20).

druid||Timeless Body.name: Timeless Body
druid||Timeless Body.summary: You age only one year for every ten that pass.

druid||Beast Spells.name: Beast Spells
druid||Beast Spells.summary: You can cast druid spells while in Wild Shape, supplying verbal and somatic components but not material ones.

druid||Archdruid.name: Archdruid
druid||Archdruid.summary: Wild Shape uses become unlimited, and you can skip verbal, somatic and costless non-consumed material components of druid spells in any form.

druid|land|Bonus Cantrip.name: Bonus Cantrip
druid|land|Bonus Cantrip.summary: Learn one extra druid cantrip of your choice.

druid|land|Natural Recovery.name: Natural Recovery
druid|land|Natural Recovery.summary: During a short rest, recover expended spell slots with a combined level up to half your druid level (rounded up); no slot of 6th level or higher.

druid|land|Circle Spells.name: Circle Spells
druid|land|Circle Spells.summary: Choose the land you were initiated in; gain its two circle spells at druid levels 3, 5, 7 and 9. They are always prepared, don't count against prepared spells and count as druid spells.

druid|land|Land's Stride.name: Land's Stride
druid|land|Land's Stride.summary: Nonmagical difficult terrain costs no extra movement; pass through nonmagical plants unslowed and unharmed; advantage on saves against magical plants that hinder movement (e.g. entangle).

druid|land|Nature's Ward.name: Nature's Ward
druid|land|Nature's Ward.summary: Elementals and fey can't charm or frighten you, and you are immune to poison and disease.

druid|land|Nature's Sanctuary.name: Nature's Sanctuary
druid|land|Nature's Sanctuary.summary: A beast or plant attacking you must pass a Wis save vs. your spell DC or pick another target (or miss). On a success it is immune for 24 hours; it knows of this effect beforehand.

druid|opt|Circle Spells|Arctic.name: Arctic
druid|opt|Circle Spells|Arctic.summary: 3: Hold Person, Spike Growth; 5: Sleet Storm, Slow; 7: Freedom of Movement, Ice Storm; 9: Commune with Nature, Cone of Cold

druid|opt|Circle Spells|Coast.name: Coast
druid|opt|Circle Spells|Coast.summary: 3: Mirror Image, Misty Step; 5: Water Breathing, Water Walk; 7: Control Water, Freedom of Movement; 9: Conjure Elemental, Scrying

druid|opt|Circle Spells|Desert.name: Desert
druid|opt|Circle Spells|Desert.summary: 3: Blur, Silence; 5: Create Food and Water, Protection from Energy; 7: Blight, Hallucinatory Terrain; 9: Insect Plague, Wall of Stone

druid|opt|Circle Spells|Forest.name: Forest
druid|opt|Circle Spells|Forest.summary: 3: Barkskin, Spider Climb; 5: Call Lightning, Plant Growth; 7: Divination, Freedom of Movement; 9: Commune with Nature, Tree Stride

druid|opt|Circle Spells|Grassland.name: Grassland
druid|opt|Circle Spells|Grassland.summary: 3: Invisibility, Pass without Trace; 5: Daylight, Haste; 7: Divination, Freedom of Movement; 9: Dream, Insect Plague

druid|opt|Circle Spells|Mountain.name: Mountain
druid|opt|Circle Spells|Mountain.summary: 3: Spider Climb, Spike Growth; 5: Lightning Bolt, Meld into Stone; 7: Stone Shape, Stoneskin; 9: Passwall, Wall of Stone

druid|opt|Circle Spells|Swamp.name: Swamp
druid|opt|Circle Spells|Swamp.summary: 3: Darkness, Melf's Acid Arrow; 5: Water Walk, Stinking Cloud; 7: Freedom of Movement, Locate Creature; 9: Insect Plague, Scrying

druid|opt|Circle Spells|Underdark.name: Underdark
druid|opt|Circle Spells|Underdark.summary: 3: Spider Climb, Web; 5: Gaseous Form, Stinking Cloud; 7: Greater Invisibility, Stone Shape; 9: Cloudkill, Insect Plague

druid|moon|Combat Wild Shape.name: Combat Wild Shape
druid|moon|Combat Wild Shape.summary: Wild Shape takes a bonus action instead of an action. While transformed, bonus action: spend a spell slot to regain 1d8 HP per slot level.

druid|moon|Circle Forms.name: Circle Forms
druid|moon|Circle Forms.summary: Wild Shape max CR becomes 1 at 2nd level (ignore the Beast Shapes CR column but keep its movement limits), and druid level / 3 (rounded down) from 6th level.

druid|moon|Primal Strike.name: Primal Strike
druid|moon|Primal Strike.summary: Your beast-form attacks count as magical for overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage.

druid|moon|Elemental Wild Shape.name: Elemental Wild Shape
druid|moon|Elemental Wild Shape.summary: Spend two Wild Shape uses at once to become an air, earth, fire or water elemental.

druid|opt|Wild Shape|Beast Shapes: 2nd l.name: Beast Shapes: 2nd level
druid|opt|Wild Shape|Beast Shapes: 2nd l.summary: Max CR 1/4; no flying or swimming speed (e.g. wolf).

druid|opt|Wild Shape|Beast Shapes: 4th l.name: Beast Shapes: 4th level
druid|opt|Wild Shape|Beast Shapes: 4th l.summary: Max CR 1/2; no flying speed (e.g. crocodile).

druid|opt|Wild Shape|Beast Shapes: 8th l.name: Beast Shapes: 8th level
druid|opt|Wild Shape|Beast Shapes: 8th l.summary: Max CR 1; no movement restriction (e.g. giant eagle).

fighter||Fighting Style.name: Fighting Style
fighter||Fighting Style.summary: Pick one fighting style option (see options); the same style can never be taken twice, even when another choice is granted later.

fighter||Second Wind.name: Second Wind
fighter||Second Wind.summary: Bonus action on your turn: heal 1d10 + fighter level hit points. Usable once per short or long rest.

fighter||Action Surge.name: Action Surge
fighter||Action Surge.summary: On your turn, take one extra action. Recharges on a short or long rest; from 17th level two uses per rest, but never twice in one turn.

fighter||Martial Archetype.name: Martial Archetype
fighter||Martial Archetype.summary: Choose Champion, Battle Master or Eldritch Knight; the archetype grants features at 3rd, 7th, 10th, 15th and 18th level.

fighter||Ability Score Improvement.name: Ability Score Improvement
fighter||Ability Score Improvement.summary: At 4th, 6th, 8th, 12th, 14th, 16th and 19th level: +2 to one ability score or +1 to two, to a maximum of 20.

fighter||Extra Attack.name: Extra Attack
fighter||Extra Attack.summary: The Attack action lets you attack twice; three attacks from 11th fighter level and four from 20th.

fighter||Indomitable.name: Indomitable
fighter||Indomitable.summary: Reroll a failed saving throw and keep the new result. Once per long rest; twice from 13th level, three times from 17th.

fighter|champion|Improved Critical.name: Improved Critical
fighter|champion|Improved Critical.summary: Weapon attacks crit on a 19 or 20.

fighter|champion|Remarkable Athlete.name: Remarkable Athlete
fighter|champion|Remarkable Athlete.summary: Add half proficiency bonus (rounded up) to Str, Dex and Con checks that don't already use proficiency; running long jumps gain feet equal to your Strength modifier.

fighter|champion|Additional Fighting Sty.name: Additional Fighting Style
fighter|champion|Additional Fighting Sty.summary: Choose a second Fighting Style option.

fighter|champion|Survivor.name: Survivor
fighter|champion|Survivor.summary: At the start of each turn, if at or below half hit points (but above 0), regain 5 + Constitution modifier hit points.

fighter|battle-master|Combat Superiority.name: Combat Superiority
fighter|battle-master|Combat Superiority.summary: Learn 3 maneuvers (2 more at 7th, 10th and 15th; may swap one each time) fueled by superiority dice: 4d8, +1 die at 7th and 15th, regained on a short or long rest. One maneuver per attack; save DC 8 + prof + Str or Dex modifier.

fighter|res|superiority-dice.name: Superiority Dice (d8; d10 at 10th, d12 at 18th)

fighter|battle-master|Student of War.name: Student of War
fighter|battle-master|Student of War.summary: Gain proficiency with one type of artisan's tools of your choice.

fighter|battle-master|Know Your Enemy.name: Know Your Enemy
fighter|battle-master|Know Your Enemy.summary: After 1 minute observing or interacting with a creature out of combat, learn whether it is your equal, superior or inferior in two chosen traits (Str, Dex, Con, AC, current HP, total class levels, fighter levels).

fighter|battle-master|Improved Combat Su.name: Improved Combat Superiority
fighter|battle-master|Improved Combat Su.summary: Superiority dice become d10s; at 18th level they become d12s.

fighter|battle-master|Relentless.name: Relentless
fighter|battle-master|Relentless.summary: When you roll initiative with no superiority dice left, regain one.

fighter|opt|Combat Superiority|Commander.name: Commander's Strike
fighter|opt|Combat Superiority|Commander.summary: Give up one of your Attack-action attacks and use a bonus action plus a die: an ally who can see or hear you uses its reaction to make a weapon attack, adding the die to damage.

fighter|opt|Combat Superiority|Disarming.name: Disarming Attack
fighter|opt|Combat Superiority|Disarming.summary: On a weapon hit, add the die to damage; target makes a Strength save or drops an item of your choice at its feet.

fighter|opt|Combat Superiority|Distracti.name: Distracting Strike
fighter|opt|Combat Superiority|Distracti.summary: On a weapon hit, add the die to damage; the next attack by someone other than you against that target before your next turn has advantage.

fighter|opt|Combat Superiority|Evasive F.name: Evasive Footwork
fighter|opt|Combat Superiority|Evasive F.summary: While moving, spend a die and add the roll to your AC until you stop moving.

fighter|opt|Combat Superiority|Feinting.name: Feinting Attack
fighter|opt|Combat Superiority|Feinting.summary: Bonus action plus a die to feint a creature within 5 feet: advantage on your next attack against it this turn, adding the die to damage if it hits.

fighter|opt|Combat Superiority|Goading A.name: Goading Attack
fighter|opt|Combat Superiority|Goading A.summary: On a weapon hit, add the die to damage; target makes a Wisdom save or has disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you until the end of your next turn.

fighter|opt|Combat Superiority|Lunging A.name: Lunging Attack
fighter|opt|Combat Superiority|Lunging A.summary: On a melee weapon attack on your turn, spend a die to gain 5 extra feet of reach for that attack; add the die to damage on a hit.

fighter|opt|Combat Superiority|Maneuveri.name: Maneuvering Attack
fighter|opt|Combat Superiority|Maneuveri.summary: On a weapon hit, add the die to damage; an ally who can see or hear you may use its reaction to move half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks from the target.

fighter|opt|Combat Superiority|Menacing.name: Menacing Attack
fighter|opt|Combat Superiority|Menacing.summary: On a weapon hit, add the die to damage; target makes a Wisdom save or is frightened of you until the end of your next turn.

fighter|opt|Combat Superiority|Parry.name: Parry
fighter|opt|Combat Superiority|Parry.summary: Reaction when a melee attack damages you: reduce the damage by the die roll + your Dexterity modifier.

fighter|opt|Combat Superiority|Precision.name: Precision Attack
fighter|opt|Combat Superiority|Precision.summary: Add the die to a weapon attack roll, before or after rolling but before effects are applied.

fighter|opt|Combat Superiority|Pushing A.name: Pushing Attack
fighter|opt|Combat Superiority|Pushing A.summary: On a weapon hit, add the die to damage; a Large or smaller target makes a Strength save or is pushed up to 15 feet away.

fighter|opt|Combat Superiority|Rally.name: Rally
fighter|opt|Combat Superiority|Rally.summary: Bonus action plus a die: an ally who can see or hear you gains temporary hit points equal to the die roll + your Charisma modifier.

fighter|opt|Combat Superiority|Riposte.name: Riposte
fighter|opt|Combat Superiority|Riposte.summary: Reaction when a creature misses you with a melee attack: make one melee weapon attack against it, adding the die to damage on a hit.

fighter|opt|Combat Superiority|Sweeping.name: Sweeping Attack
fighter|opt|Combat Superiority|Sweeping.summary: On a melee weapon hit, choose a second creature within 5 feet of the target and within reach; if the original roll would hit it, it takes the die roll as damage of the same type.

fighter|opt|Combat Superiority|Trip Atta.name: Trip Attack
fighter|opt|Combat Superiority|Trip Atta.summary: On a weapon hit, add the die to damage; a Large or smaller target makes a Strength save or is knocked prone.

fighter|eldritch-knight|Spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
fighter|eldritch-knight|Spellcasting.summary: Cast wizard spells using Intelligence (see spellcasting table). Spells known must be abjuration or evocation, except the ones learned at 3rd (one of the first three), 8th, 14th and 20th level; slots regained on a long rest.

fighter|eldritch-knight|Weapon Bond.name: Weapon Bond
fighter|eldritch-knight|Weapon Bond.summary: A 1-hour ritual bonds up to two weapons to you; a bonded weapon can't be disarmed unless you are incapacitated and can be summoned to your hand as a bonus action on the same plane.

fighter|eldritch-knight|War Magic.name: War Magic
fighter|eldritch-knight|War Magic.summary: After using your action to cast a cantrip, you may make one weapon attack as a bonus action.

fighter|eldritch-knight|Eldritch Strike.name: Eldritch Strike
fighter|eldritch-knight|Eldritch Strike.summary: A creature you hit with a weapon attack has disadvantage on its next save against a spell you cast before the end of your next turn.

fighter|eldritch-knight|Arcane Charge.name: Arcane Charge
fighter|eldritch-knight|Arcane Charge.summary: When you use Action Surge, you may teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see, before or after the extra action.

fighter|eldritch-knight|Improved War Mag.name: Improved War Magic
fighter|eldritch-knight|Improved War Mag.summary: After using your action to cast any spell, you may make one weapon attack as a bonus action.

fighter|opt|Fighting Style|Archery.name: Archery
fighter|opt|Fighting Style|Archery.summary: +2 to attack rolls with ranged weapons.

fighter|opt|Fighting Style|Dueling.name: Dueling
fighter|opt|Fighting Style|Dueling.summary: +2 damage with a melee weapon held in one hand when you wield no other weapon.

fighter|opt|Fighting Style|Great Weapon.name: Great Weapon Fighting
fighter|opt|Fighting Style|Great Weapon.summary: Reroll 1s and 2s on damage dice for two-handed melee attacks with a two-handed or versatile weapon; the reroll stands.

fighter|opt|Fighting Style|Protection.name: Protection
fighter|opt|Fighting Style|Protection.summary: While holding a shield, use your reaction to give disadvantage to an attack against another creature within 5 feet of you that you can see.

fighter|opt|Fighting Style|Two-Weapon Fi.name: Two-Weapon Fighting
fighter|opt|Fighting Style|Two-Weapon Fi.summary: Add your ability modifier to the damage of the off-hand attack when two-weapon fighting.

monk||Unarmored Defense.name: Unarmored Defense
monk||Unarmored Defense.summary: With no armor and no shield, AC = 10 + Dex modifier + Wis modifier.

monk||Martial Arts.name: Martial Arts
monk||Martial Arts.summary: Unarmed or with monk weapons (shortswords, simple melee weapons without two-handed/heavy) and no armor/shield: use Dex for attack and damage, use the Martial Arts die for damage, and make a bonus-action unarmed strike after attacking with the Attack action.

monk||Ki.name: Ki
monk||Ki.summary: Pool of ki points equal to the Ki Points column, regained on a short or long rest with 30 minutes of meditation. Ki save DC = 8 + prof + Wis. Grants Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense and Step of the Wind.

monk||Flurry of Blows.name: Flurry of Blows
monk||Flurry of Blows.summary: Right after the Attack action, spend 1 ki to make two unarmed strikes as a bonus action.

monk||Patient Defense.name: Patient Defense
monk||Patient Defense.summary: Spend 1 ki to Dodge as a bonus action on your turn.

monk||Step of the Wind.name: Step of the Wind
monk||Step of the Wind.summary: Spend 1 ki to Disengage or Dash as a bonus action; jump distance doubles for the turn.

monk||Unarmored Movement.name: Unarmored Movement
monk||Unarmored Movement.summary: Speed bonus per the Unarmored Movement column while unarmored and without a shield. From 9th level, you can run up vertical surfaces and across liquids during your move.

monk||Monastic Tradition.name: Monastic Tradition
monk||Monastic Tradition.summary: Choose Way of the Open Hand, Way of Shadow or Way of the Four Elements; features at 3rd, 6th, 11th and 17th level.

monk||Deflect Missiles.name: Deflect Missiles
monk||Deflect Missiles.summary: Reaction when hit by a ranged weapon attack: reduce damage by 1d10 + Dex modifier + monk level. If reduced to 0 and you have a free hand, catch it and may spend 1 ki to throw it back as a monk-weapon attack with proficiency.

monk||Ability Score Improvement.name: Ability Score Improvement
monk||Ability Score Improvement.summary: At 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th and 19th level: +2 to one ability score or +1 to two, to a maximum of 20.

monk||Slow Fall.name: Slow Fall
monk||Slow Fall.summary: Reaction while falling: reduce fall damage by 5 x monk level.

monk||Extra Attack.name: Extra Attack
monk||Extra Attack.summary: Attack twice when you take the Attack action.

monk||Stunning Strike.name: Stunning Strike
monk||Stunning Strike.summary: On a melee weapon hit, spend 1 ki: target makes a Con save or is stunned until the end of your next turn.

monk||Ki-Empowered Strikes.name: Ki-Empowered Strikes
monk||Ki-Empowered Strikes.summary: Unarmed strikes count as magical for overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical damage.

monk||Evasion.name: Evasion
monk||Evasion.summary: On a Dex save for half damage: no damage on a success, half on a failure.

monk||Stillness of Mind.name: Stillness of Mind
monk||Stillness of Mind.summary: Use your action to end one charmed or frightened effect on yourself.

monk||Tongue of the Sun and Moon.name: Tongue of the Sun and Moon
monk||Tongue of the Sun and Moon.summary: Understand all spoken languages, and any creature that knows a language understands your speech.

monk||Diamond Soul.name: Diamond Soul
monk||Diamond Soul.summary: Proficiency in all saving throws; spend 1 ki to reroll a failed save and use the new result.

monk||Timeless Body.name: Timeless Body
monk||Timeless Body.summary: No frailty from old age, immune to magical aging, and no longer need food or water (can still die of old age).

monk||Empty Body.name: Empty Body
monk||Empty Body.summary: Action + 4 ki: invisible for 1 minute with resistance to all damage except force. 8 ki: cast astral projection without material components, on yourself only.

monk||Perfect Self.name: Perfect Self
monk||Perfect Self.summary: When you roll initiative with 0 ki remaining, regain 4 ki.

monk|open-hand|Open Hand Technique.name: Open Hand Technique
monk|open-hand|Open Hand Technique.summary: Flurry of Blows hits can impose one effect: Dex save or prone, Str save or pushed up to 15 ft, or no reactions until the end of your next turn.

monk|open-hand|Wholeness of Body.name: Wholeness of Body
monk|open-hand|Wholeness of Body.summary: Action: regain hit points equal to 3 x monk level. Once per long rest.

monk|open-hand|Tranquility.name: Tranquility
monk|open-hand|Tranquility.summary: At the end of each long rest, gain a sanctuary effect lasting until your next long rest (save DC 8 + Wis + prof); ends early as the spell does.

monk|open-hand|Quivering Palm.name: Quivering Palm
monk|open-hand|Quivering Palm.summary: On an unarmed hit, spend 3 ki to plant vibrations lasting monk-level days; later use an action (same plane) to force a Con save: fail drops it to 0 HP, success deals 10d10 necrotic. One target at a time.

monk|shadow|Shadow Arts.name: Shadow Arts
monk|shadow|Shadow Arts.summary: Action + 2 ki: cast darkness, darkvision, pass without trace or silence with no material components. Also learn the minor illusion cantrip if you lack it.

monk|shadow|Shadow Step.name: Shadow Step
monk|shadow|Shadow Step.summary: In dim light or darkness, bonus action to teleport up to 60 ft to another dim or dark space you can see; advantage on your first melee attack before the end of the turn.

monk|shadow|Cloak of Shadows.name: Cloak of Shadows
monk|shadow|Cloak of Shadows.summary: In dim light or darkness, use your action to become invisible until you attack, cast a spell, or enter bright light.

monk|shadow|Opportunist.name: Opportunist
monk|shadow|Opportunist.summary: Reaction when a creature within 5 ft is hit by someone else's attack: make a melee attack against it.

monk|four-elements|Disciple of the Eleme.name: Disciple of the Elements
monk|four-elements|Disciple of the Eleme.summary: Know Elemental Attunement plus one other elemental discipline; learn one more at 6th, 11th and 17th level (may swap one each time). Discipline spells need no material components; from 5th level extra ki upcasts them, capped by the Spells and Ki Points table (3 ki at 5th-8th, 4 at 9th-12th, 5 at 13th-16th, 6 at 17th-20th).

monk|opt|Disciple of the Elements|Elemen.name: Elemental Attunement
monk|opt|Disciple of the Elements|Elemen.summary: Action: minor elemental tricks - harmless sensory effect, light/snuff a small flame, chill or warm up to 1 lb for 1 hour, or shape a 1-foot cube of earth, fire, water or mist for 1 minute.

monk|opt|Disciple of the Elements|Fangs.name: Fangs of the Fire Snake
monk|opt|Disciple of the Elements|Fangs.summary: 1 ki when taking the Attack action: unarmed reach +10 ft for the turn and those hits deal fire damage; +1 ki on a hit for an extra 1d10 fire.

monk|opt|Disciple of the Elements|Fist o.name: Fist of Unbroken Air
monk|opt|Disciple of the Elements|Fist o.summary: Action + 2 ki: creature within 30 ft makes a Str save or takes 3d10 bludgeoning (+1d10 per extra ki), is pushed up to 20 ft and knocked prone; half damage only on a success.

monk|opt|Disciple of the Elements|Mist S.name: Mist Stance
monk|opt|Disciple of the Elements|Mist S.summary: 4 ki: cast gaseous form on yourself.

monk|opt|Disciple of the Elements|Shape.name: Shape the Flowing River
monk|opt|Disciple of the Elements|Shape.summary: Action + 1 ki: reshape ice or water in a cube up to 30 ft on a side within 120 ft - freeze/thaw, raise or lower elevation, dig trenches, raise walls or pillars (changes up to half the largest dimension; can't trap or harm creatures).

monk|opt|Disciple of the Elements|Water.name: Water Whip
monk|opt|Disciple of the Elements|Water.summary: Bonus action + 2 ki: creature within 30 ft makes a Dex save or takes 3d10 bludgeoning (+1d10 per extra ki) and is knocked prone or pulled up to 25 ft closer; half damage only on a success.

paladin||Divine Sense.name: Divine Sense
paladin||Divine Sense.summary: Action: until the end of your next turn, learn the location and type (celestial, fiend, undead) of such creatures within 60 ft. not behind total cover, plus consecrated/desecrated places or objects.

paladin||Lay on Hands.name: Lay on Hands
paladin||Lay on Hands.summary: Healing pool of 5 x paladin level HP. Action, touch: restore any amount of HP from the pool, or spend 5 points per disease cured / poison neutralized. No effect on undead or constructs.

paladin||Fighting Style.name: Fighting Style
paladin||Fighting Style.summary: Pick one fighting style from the paladin list (Defense, Dueling, Great Weapon Fighting, Protection). The same style can never be taken twice.

paladin||Spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
paladin||Spellcasting.summary: Half-caster using Charisma. Prepare CHA mod + half paladin level (round down, min 1) spells from the paladin list after a long rest; slots per the class table. Holy symbol can be a focus.

paladin||Divine Smite.name: Divine Smite
paladin||Divine Smite.summary: On a melee weapon hit, spend a paladin spell slot for extra radiant damage: 2d8 for 1st level, +1d8 per slot level above 1st (max 5d8), +1d8 more vs. undead or fiends.

paladin||Sacred Oath.name: Sacred Oath
paladin||Sacred Oath.summary: Swear an oath (Devotion, Ancients, or Vengeance). It grants features at 3rd, 7th, 15th, and 20th level, including oath spells and Channel Divinity options.

paladin||Oath Spells.name: Oath Spells
paladin||Oath Spells.summary: Part of Sacred Oath. Each oath lists spells gained at paladin levels 3/5/9/13/17; they are always prepared, don't count against your prepared total, and count as paladin spells.

paladin||Channel Divinity.name: Channel Divinity
paladin||Channel Divinity.summary: Part of Sacred Oath. Use one Channel Divinity option granted by your oath; then you must finish a short or long rest before using it again. Save DC = your paladin spell save DC.

paladin||Ability Score Improvement.name: Ability Score Improvement
paladin||Ability Score Improvement.summary: At 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th and 19th level: +2 to one ability score or +1 to two, max 20.

paladin||Extra Attack.name: Extra Attack
paladin||Extra Attack.summary: When you take the Attack action, you make two attacks instead of one.

paladin||Aura of Protection.name: Aura of Protection
paladin||Aura of Protection.summary: While you are conscious, you and friendly creatures within 10 ft. add your Charisma modifier (minimum +1) to all saving throws. Range becomes 30 ft. at 18th level.

paladin||Aura of Courage.name: Aura of Courage
paladin||Aura of Courage.summary: While you are conscious, you and friendly creatures within 10 ft. can't be frightened. Range becomes 30 ft. at 18th level.

paladin||Improved Divine Smite.name: Improved Divine Smite
paladin||Improved Divine Smite.summary: Every melee weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 radiant damage; this stacks with Divine Smite.

paladin||Cleansing Touch.name: Cleansing Touch
paladin||Cleansing Touch.summary: Action: end one spell on yourself or on a willing creature you touch.

paladin||Aura improvements.name: Aura improvements
paladin||Aura improvements.summary: Your paladin auras (Aura of Protection, Aura of Courage, and your oath's 7th-level aura) extend from 10 ft. to 30 ft.

paladin|devotion|Oath Spells.name: Oath Spells
paladin|devotion|Oath Spells.summary: Always-prepared Oath of Devotion spells (see spells).

paladin|devotion|Sacred Weapon.name: Sacred Weapon
paladin|devotion|Sacred Weapon.summary: Channel Divinity, action: for 1 minute a held weapon adds your CHA mod (min +1) to attack rolls, sheds bright light 20 ft. (dim 20 ft. more), and counts as magical. Ends if dropped or you fall unconscious.

paladin|devotion|Turn the Unholy.name: Turn the Unholy
paladin|devotion|Turn the Unholy.summary: Channel Divinity, action: each fiend or undead within 30 ft. that can see or hear you makes a WIS save or is turned for 1 minute or until damaged (must flee, no reactions, only Dash/escape/Dodge).

paladin|devotion|Aura of Devotion.name: Aura of Devotion
paladin|devotion|Aura of Devotion.summary: While you are conscious, you and friendly creatures within 10 ft. can't be charmed. Range becomes 30 ft. at 18th level.

paladin|devotion|Purity of Spirit.name: Purity of Spirit
paladin|devotion|Purity of Spirit.summary: You are permanently under the effect of protection from evil and good.

paladin|devotion|Holy Nimbus.name: Holy Nimbus
paladin|devotion|Holy Nimbus.summary: Action: for 1 minute emit bright sunlight 30 ft. (dim 30 ft. more); enemies starting their turn in the bright light take 10 radiant damage; you have advantage on saves vs. spells cast by fiends or undead.

paladin|opt|Channel Divinity|Sacred Weap.name: Sacred Weapon
paladin|opt|Channel Divinity|Sacred Weap.summary: Empower a held weapon: +CHA to attacks, light, magical, 1 minute.

paladin|opt|Channel Divinity|Turn the Un.name: Turn the Unholy
paladin|opt|Channel Divinity|Turn the Un.summary: Turn fiends and undead within 30 ft. on a failed WIS save.

paladin|ancients|Oath Spells.name: Oath Spells
paladin|ancients|Oath Spells.summary: Always-prepared Oath of the Ancients spells (see spells).

paladin|ancients|Nature's Wrath.name: Nature's Wrath
paladin|ancients|Nature's Wrath.summary: Channel Divinity, action: spectral vines attack a creature within 10 ft. that you can see; it makes a STR or DEX save (its choice) or is restrained, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns.

paladin|ancients|Turn the Faithless.name: Turn the Faithless
paladin|ancients|Turn the Faithless.summary: Channel Divinity, action: each fey or fiend within 30 ft. that can hear you makes a WIS save or is turned for 1 minute or until damaged; a turned creature's disguised true form is revealed.

paladin|ancients|Aura of Warding.name: Aura of Warding
paladin|ancients|Aura of Warding.summary: You and friendly creatures within 10 ft. have resistance to damage from spells. Range becomes 30 ft. at 18th level.

paladin|ancients|Undying Sentinel.name: Undying Sentinel
paladin|ancients|Undying Sentinel.summary: When reduced to 0 HP but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 HP instead. You also suffer no drawbacks of old age and can't be magically aged.

paladin|ancients|Elder Champion.name: Elder Champion
paladin|ancients|Elder Champion.summary: Action: transform for 1 minute. Regain 10 HP at the start of each of your turns, cast 1-action paladin spells as a bonus action, and enemies within 10 ft. have disadvantage on saves vs. your paladin spells and Channel Divinity.

paladin|opt|Channel Divinity|Nature's Wr.name: Nature's Wrath
paladin|opt|Channel Divinity|Nature's Wr.summary: Restrain one creature within 10 ft. with spectral vines (STR or DEX save).

paladin|opt|Channel Divinity|Turn the Fa.name: Turn the Faithless
paladin|opt|Channel Divinity|Turn the Fa.summary: Turn fey and fiends within 30 ft. on a failed WIS save.

paladin|vengeance|Oath Spells.name: Oath Spells
paladin|vengeance|Oath Spells.summary: Always-prepared Oath of Vengeance spells (see spells).

paladin|vengeance|Abjure Enemy.name: Abjure Enemy
paladin|vengeance|Abjure Enemy.summary: Channel Divinity, action: one creature within 60 ft. you can see makes a WIS save (fiends/undead at disadvantage; frighten-immune creatures unaffected). Fail: frightened 1 minute or until damaged, speed 0. Success: speed halved 1 minute or until damaged.

paladin|vengeance|Vow of Enmity.name: Vow of Enmity
paladin|vengeance|Vow of Enmity.summary: Channel Divinity, bonus action: choose a creature within 10 ft. you can see; you have advantage on attack rolls against it for 1 minute or until it drops to 0 HP or falls unconscious.

paladin|vengeance|Relentless Avenger.name: Relentless Avenger
paladin|vengeance|Relentless Avenger.summary: When you hit with an opportunity attack, you may move up to half your speed as part of that reaction, without provoking opportunity attacks.

paladin|vengeance|Soul of Vengeance.name: Soul of Vengeance
paladin|vengeance|Soul of Vengeance.summary: When the target of your Vow of Enmity makes an attack, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against it if it is in range.

paladin|vengeance|Avenging Angel.name: Avenging Angel
paladin|vengeance|Avenging Angel.summary: Action: transform for 1 hour. Gain a 60 ft. flying speed and a 30 ft. aura; enemies entering or starting a turn there for the first time make a WIS save or are frightened 1 minute or until damaged, and attacks against them have advantage.

paladin|opt|Channel Divinity|Abjure Enem.name: Abjure Enemy
paladin|opt|Channel Divinity|Abjure Enem.summary: Frighten and root one creature within 60 ft. (WIS save).

paladin|opt|Channel Divinity|Vow of Enmi.name: Vow of Enmity
paladin|opt|Channel Divinity|Vow of Enmi.summary: Advantage on attacks vs. one creature within 10 ft. for 1 minute.

paladin|opt|Fighting Style|Dueling.name: Dueling
paladin|opt|Fighting Style|Dueling.summary: +2 damage with a melee weapon held in one hand when you hold no other weapon.

paladin|opt|Fighting Style|Great Weapon.name: Great Weapon Fighting
paladin|opt|Fighting Style|Great Weapon.summary: Reroll 1s and 2s on damage dice for two-handed melee weapon attacks (weapon must be two-handed or versatile); must keep the new roll.

paladin|opt|Fighting Style|Protection.name: Protection
paladin|opt|Fighting Style|Protection.summary: Reaction: impose disadvantage on an attack against a creature (not you) within 5 ft. of you that you can see. Requires a shield.

ranger||Favored Enemy.name: Favored Enemy
ranger||Favored Enemy.summary: Pick a creature type (or two humanoid races). Advantage on WIS (Survival) to track them and INT checks to recall lore about them; learn one of their languages. Extra choice (and language) at 6th and 14th level.

ranger||Natural Explorer.name: Natural Explorer
ranger||Natural Explorer.summary: Pick a favored terrain: double proficiency on proficient INT/WIS checks about it, and travel perks there (no slowdown from difficult terrain, can't get lost, double forage, etc.). Extra terrain at 6th and 10th level.

ranger||Fighting Style.name: Fighting Style
ranger||Fighting Style.summary: Pick one fighting style from the ranger list (Archery, Defense, Dueling, Two-Weapon Fighting). The same style can never be taken twice.

ranger||Spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
ranger||Spellcasting.summary: Half-caster using Wisdom with a fixed number of known spells (Spells Known column); can swap one known spell on each ranger level-up. Slots per the class table, regained on a long rest.

ranger||Ranger Archetype.name: Ranger Archetype
ranger||Ranger Archetype.summary: Choose Hunter or Beast Master; the archetype grants features at 3rd, 7th, 11th and 15th level.

ranger||Primeval Awareness.name: Primeval Awareness
ranger||Primeval Awareness.summary: Action + one ranger spell slot: for 1 minute per slot level, sense whether aberrations, celestials, dragons, elementals, fey, fiends or undead are within 1 mile (6 miles in favored terrain); no location or count.

ranger||Ability Score Improvement.name: Ability Score Improvement
ranger||Ability Score Improvement.summary: At 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th and 19th level: +2 to one ability score or +1 to two, max 20.

ranger||Extra Attack.name: Extra Attack
ranger||Extra Attack.summary: When you take the Attack action, you make two attacks instead of one.

ranger||Land's Stride.name: Land's Stride
ranger||Land's Stride.summary: Nonmagical difficult terrain costs no extra movement; pass through nonmagical plants unhindered and unharmed by thorns; advantage on saves vs. magical plants that impede movement (e.g. entangle).

ranger||Hide in Plain Sight.name: Hide in Plain Sight
ranger||Hide in Plain Sight.summary: Spend 1 minute camouflaging with natural materials; while pressed against a solid surface at least your size and not moving or acting, gain +10 to DEX (Stealth). Moving or acting ends it.

ranger||Vanish.name: Vanish
ranger||Vanish.summary: Take the Hide action as a bonus action; you can't be tracked by nonmagical means unless you choose to leave a trail.

ranger||Feral Senses.name: Feral Senses
ranger||Feral Senses.summary: Not seeing a creature doesn't give you disadvantage on attacks against it; you know where invisible creatures within 30 ft. are if they aren't hidden and you aren't blinded or deafened.

ranger||Foe Slayer.name: Foe Slayer
ranger||Foe Slayer.summary: Once per turn, add your WIS modifier to the attack roll or damage roll of an attack against a favored enemy, choosing before or after the roll but before effects apply.

ranger|hunter|Hunter's Prey.name: Hunter's Prey
ranger|hunter|Hunter's Prey.summary: Choose one: Colossus Slayer, Giant Killer, or Horde Breaker.

ranger|hunter|Defensive Tactics.name: Defensive Tactics
ranger|hunter|Defensive Tactics.summary: Choose one: Escape the Horde, Multiattack Defense, or Steel Will.

ranger|hunter|Multiattack.name: Multiattack
ranger|hunter|Multiattack.summary: Choose one: Volley or Whirlwind Attack.

ranger|hunter|Superior Hunter's Defense.name: Superior Hunter's Defense
ranger|hunter|Superior Hunter's Defense.summary: Choose one: Evasion, Stand Against the Tide, or Uncanny Dodge.

ranger|opt|Hunter's Prey|Colossus Slayer.name: Colossus Slayer
ranger|opt|Hunter's Prey|Colossus Slayer.summary: Once per turn, a weapon hit on a creature below its HP maximum deals an extra 1d8 damage.

ranger|opt|Hunter's Prey|Giant Killer.name: Giant Killer
ranger|opt|Hunter's Prey|Giant Killer.summary: Reaction: when a Large or larger creature within 5 ft. hits or misses you, attack it right after, if you can see it.

ranger|opt|Hunter's Prey|Horde Breaker.name: Horde Breaker
ranger|opt|Hunter's Prey|Horde Breaker.summary: Once per turn, after a weapon attack, make another attack with the same weapon against a different creature within 5 ft. of the first target and in range.

ranger|opt|Defensive Tactics|Escape the.name: Escape the Horde
ranger|opt|Defensive Tactics|Escape the.summary: Opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage.

ranger|opt|Defensive Tactics|Multiattack.name: Multiattack Defense
ranger|opt|Defensive Tactics|Multiattack.summary: After a creature hits you, you get +4 AC against its later attacks this turn.

ranger|opt|Defensive Tactics|Steel Will.name: Steel Will
ranger|opt|Defensive Tactics|Steel Will.summary: Advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

ranger|opt|Multiattack|Volley.name: Volley
ranger|opt|Multiattack|Volley.summary: Action: ranged attack against any number of creatures within 10 ft. of a point in range; ammo and a separate roll per target.

ranger|opt|Multiattack|Whirlwind Attack.name: Whirlwind Attack
ranger|opt|Multiattack|Whirlwind Attack.summary: Action: melee attack against any number of creatures within 5 ft. of you, separate roll for each.

ranger|opt|Superior Hunter's Defense|Eva.name: Evasion
ranger|opt|Superior Hunter's Defense|Eva.summary: On a DEX save for half damage, take none on a success and half on a failure.

ranger|opt|Superior Hunter's Defense|Sta.name: Stand Against the Tide
ranger|opt|Superior Hunter's Defense|Sta.summary: Reaction: when a hostile creature misses you with a melee attack, make it repeat the attack against another creature of your choice.

ranger|opt|Superior Hunter's Defense|Unc.name: Uncanny Dodge
ranger|opt|Superior Hunter's Defense|Unc.summary: Reaction: halve the damage of an attack that hits you from an attacker you can see.

ranger|beast-master|Ranger's Companion.name: Ranger's Companion
ranger|beast-master|Ranger's Companion.summary: Gain a beast companion (Medium or smaller, CR 1/4 or lower). Add proficiency bonus to its AC, attacks, damage, and proficient saves/skills; HP max is the greater of normal or 4 x ranger level. It acts on your initiative only when commanded: your action orders Attack, Dash, Disengage, Dodge or Help. Replace it with 8 hours of bonding.

ranger|beast-master|Exceptional Training.name: Exceptional Training
ranger|beast-master|Exceptional Training.summary: On a turn your companion doesn't attack, a bonus action can command it to Dash, Disengage, Dodge, or Help.

ranger|beast-master|Bestial Fury.name: Bestial Fury
ranger|beast-master|Bestial Fury.summary: Your companion makes two attacks when commanded to take the Attack action.

ranger|beast-master|Share Spells.name: Share Spells
ranger|beast-master|Share Spells.summary: A spell you cast targeting yourself can also affect your companion if it is within 30 ft.

ranger|opt|Fighting Style|Archery.name: Archery
ranger|opt|Fighting Style|Archery.summary: +2 to attack rolls with ranged weapons.

ranger|opt|Fighting Style|Dueling.name: Dueling
ranger|opt|Fighting Style|Dueling.summary: +2 damage with a melee weapon held in one hand when you hold no other weapon.

ranger|opt|Fighting Style|Two-Weapon Fig.name: Two-Weapon Fighting
ranger|opt|Fighting Style|Two-Weapon Fig.summary: Add your ability modifier to the damage of the off-hand attack when two-weapon fighting.

ranger|opt|Favored Enemy|Two humanoid ra.name: Two humanoid races
ranger|opt|Favored Enemy|Two humanoid ra.summary: Instead of a creature type, pick two humanoid races (e.g. gnolls and orcs).

rogue||Expertise.name: Expertise
rogue||Expertise.summary: Pick two skill proficiencies (or one skill plus thieves' tools); your proficiency bonus is doubled for checks using them. Pick two more at 6th level.

rogue||Sneak Attack.name: Sneak Attack
rogue||Sneak Attack.summary: Once per turn, add the Sneak Attack dice to one finesse or ranged weapon hit if you have advantage, or if an active ally is within 5 ft. of the target and you lack disadvantage.

rogue||Thieves' Cant.name: Thieves' Cant
rogue||Thieves' Cant.summary: You know the secret rogue jargon for hiding messages in ordinary talk (takes four times as long) plus a set of signs and symbols for short coded messages.

rogue||Cunning Action.name: Cunning Action
rogue||Cunning Action.summary: Each turn in combat you may take a bonus action to Dash, Disengage, or Hide.

rogue||Roguish Archetype.name: Roguish Archetype
rogue||Roguish Archetype.summary: Choose Thief, Assassin, or Arcane Trickster; it grants features at 3rd, 9th, 13th, and 17th level.

rogue||Ability Score Improvement.name: Ability Score Improvement
rogue||Ability Score Improvement.summary: At 4th, 8th, 10th, 12th, 16th, and 19th level, raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (maximum 20).

rogue||Uncanny Dodge.name: Uncanny Dodge
rogue||Uncanny Dodge.summary: Reaction: when an attacker you can see hits you, halve that attack's damage.

rogue||Evasion.name: Evasion
rogue||Evasion.summary: On a Dexterity save against an effect that deals half damage on success, you take none on a success and half on a failure.

rogue||Reliable Talent.name: Reliable Talent
rogue||Reliable Talent.summary: On any ability check that adds your proficiency bonus, a d20 roll of 9 or lower counts as 10.

rogue||Blindsense.name: Blindsense
rogue||Blindsense.summary: While you can hear, you know where any hidden or invisible creature within 10 ft. of you is.

rogue||Slippery Mind.name: Slippery Mind
rogue||Slippery Mind.summary: You become proficient in Wisdom saving throws.

rogue||Elusive.name: Elusive
rogue||Elusive.summary: Unless you are incapacitated, attack rolls against you can never have advantage.

rogue||Stroke of Luck.name: Stroke of Luck
rogue||Stroke of Luck.summary: Turn a missed attack against a target in range into a hit, or treat a failed ability check's d20 as a 20. Once per short or long rest.

rogue|thief|Fast Hands.name: Fast Hands
rogue|thief|Fast Hands.summary: Cunning Action's bonus action can also be a Sleight of Hand check, using thieves' tools on a trap or lock, or the Use an Object action.

rogue|thief|Second-Story Work.name: Second-Story Work
rogue|thief|Second-Story Work.summary: Climbing costs no extra movement, and running jumps go farther by a number of feet equal to your Dexterity modifier.

rogue|thief|Supreme Sneak.name: Supreme Sneak
rogue|thief|Supreme Sneak.summary: Advantage on Stealth checks on a turn in which you move no more than half your speed.

rogue|thief|Use Magic Device.name: Use Magic Device
rogue|thief|Use Magic Device.summary: You disregard class, race, and level requirements when using magic items.

rogue|thief|Thief's Reflexes.name: Thief's Reflexes
rogue|thief|Thief's Reflexes.summary: In the first round of combat you take two turns: one at your initiative and a second at initiative minus 10. Not usable when surprised.

rogue|assassin|Bonus Proficiencies.name: Bonus Proficiencies
rogue|assassin|Bonus Proficiencies.summary: Gain proficiency with the disguise kit and the poisoner's kit.

rogue|assassin|Assassinate.name: Assassinate
rogue|assassin|Assassinate.summary: Advantage on attacks against creatures that have not yet acted in the combat; any hit against a surprised creature is a critical hit.

rogue|assassin|Infiltration Expertise.name: Infiltration Expertise
rogue|assassin|Infiltration Expertise.summary: Spend 7 days and 25 gp to build a reliable false identity (not someone else's); while you use it, others accept it unless given clear reason to doubt.

rogue|assassin|Impostor.name: Impostor
rogue|assassin|Impostor.summary: After 3 hours studying a person's speech, writing, and behaviour you can mimic them; casual observers are fooled and you get advantage on Deception checks to avoid detection.

rogue|assassin|Death Strike.name: Death Strike
rogue|assassin|Death Strike.summary: When you hit a surprised creature, it makes a Con save (DC 8 + Dex mod + prof); on a failure the attack's damage is doubled.

rogue|arcane-trickster|Spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
rogue|arcane-trickster|Spellcasting.summary: Int-based wizard spellcasting per the Arcane Trickster table: mage hand plus two other cantrips; leveled spells mostly enchantment or illusion, except those learned at 3rd, 8th, 14th, and 20th level, which may be any school.

rogue|arcane-trickster|Mage Hand Legerde.name: Mage Hand Legerdemain
rogue|arcane-trickster|Mage Hand Legerde.summary: Your mage hand can be invisible and can stow or retrieve items in containers others wear and use thieves' tools at range (Sleight of Hand vs. Perception to go unnoticed); control it with Cunning Action.

rogue|arcane-trickster|Magical Ambush.name: Magical Ambush
rogue|arcane-trickster|Magical Ambush.summary: If you are hidden when you cast a spell on a creature, it has disadvantage on saves against that spell this turn.

rogue|arcane-trickster|Versatile Trickst.name: Versatile Trickster
rogue|arcane-trickster|Versatile Trickst.summary: Bonus action: target a creature within 5 ft. of your mage hand to gain advantage on attacks against it until the end of the turn.

rogue|arcane-trickster|Spell Thief.name: Spell Thief
rogue|arcane-trickster|Spell Thief.summary: Reaction when a spell targets or includes you: caster saves with its spellcasting modifier vs. your DC; on a failure you negate it for you and, if it is 1st level or higher and castable by you, you know it for 8 hours while the caster cannot cast it.

sorcerer||Spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
sorcerer||Spellcasting.summary: Charisma-based casting from the sorcerer list; cantrips, spells known, and slots per the Sorcerer table. Swap one known spell on level-up. Arcane focus usable.

sorcerer||Sorcerous Origin.name: Sorcerous Origin
sorcerer||Sorcerous Origin.summary: Choose Draconic Bloodline or Wild Magic; it grants features at 1st, 6th, 14th, and 18th level.

sorcerer||Font of Magic.name: Font of Magic
sorcerer||Font of Magic.summary: Gain sorcery points (table column, regained on a long rest). Flexible Casting: bonus action to turn points into a slot of up to 5th level, or a slot into points equal to its level.

sorcerer||Metamagic.name: Metamagic
sorcerer||Metamagic.summary: Learn two Metamagic options, plus one more at 10th and 17th level. Normally only one option can be applied per spell.

sorcerer||Ability Score Improvement.name: Ability Score Improvement
sorcerer||Ability Score Improvement.summary: At 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th, and 19th level, raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (maximum 20).

sorcerer||Sorcerous Restoration.name: Sorcerous Restoration
sorcerer||Sorcerous Restoration.summary: Regain 4 spent sorcery points whenever you finish a short rest.

sorcerer|draconic|Dragon Ancestor.name: Dragon Ancestor
sorcerer|draconic|Dragon Ancestor.summary: Choose a dragon type (sets your ancestry damage type). You know Draconic, and double your proficiency bonus on Charisma checks with dragons when it applies.

sorcerer|draconic|Draconic Resilience.name: Draconic Resilience
sorcerer|draconic|Draconic Resilience.summary: +1 hit point maximum per sorcerer level; unarmored AC is 13 + Dex modifier.

sorcerer|draconic|Elemental Affinity.name: Elemental Affinity
sorcerer|draconic|Elemental Affinity.summary: Add Cha modifier to damage from spells of your ancestry type; spend 1 sorcery point to resist that type for 1 hour.

sorcerer|draconic|Dragon Wings.name: Dragon Wings
sorcerer|draconic|Dragon Wings.summary: Bonus action to grow or dismiss wings giving a fly speed equal to your speed; not while wearing armor not made for them.

sorcerer|draconic|Draconic Presence.name: Draconic Presence
sorcerer|draconic|Draconic Presence.summary: Action, 5 sorcery points: 60-ft. aura (concentration, up to 1 minute); hostiles starting their turn in it make a Wis save or are charmed (awe) or frightened (fear); success grants 24-hour immunity.

sorcerer|wild-magic|Wild Magic Surge.name: Wild Magic Surge
sorcerer|wild-magic|Wild Magic Surge.summary: After you cast a 1st-level or higher sorcerer spell, the DM may have you roll a d20; on a 1, roll on the Wild Magic Surge table.

sorcerer|wild-magic|Tides of Chaos.name: Tides of Chaos
sorcerer|wild-magic|Tides of Chaos.summary: Gain advantage on one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw. Recharges on a long rest, or early if the DM triggers a surge roll after you cast a 1st-level+ sorcerer spell.

sorcerer|wild-magic|Bend Luck.name: Bend Luck
sorcerer|wild-magic|Bend Luck.summary: Reaction, 2 sorcery points: when a creature you see makes an attack, check, or save, add or subtract 1d4 from its roll (after the roll, before effects).

sorcerer|wild-magic|Controlled Chaos.name: Controlled Chaos
sorcerer|wild-magic|Controlled Chaos.summary: When rolling on the Wild Magic Surge table, roll twice and pick either result.

sorcerer|wild-magic|Spell Bombardment.name: Spell Bombardment
sorcerer|wild-magic|Spell Bombardment.summary: Once per turn, when a spell damage die rolls its maximum, roll one such die again and add it to the damage.

sorcerer|opt|Wild Magic Surge|Wild Magic.name: Wild Magic Surge table (d100)
sorcerer|opt|Wild Magic Surge|Wild Magic.summary: 50 random effects in paired d100 bands (01-02 ... 99-00): self-centered spells (fireball, confusion, fog cloud, polymorph, etc.), teleports, cosmetic changes, short buffs or curses, summoned creatures, and at 99-00 regaining all sorcery points.

sorcerer|opt|Metamagic|Careful Spell.name: Careful Spell
sorcerer|opt|Metamagic|Careful Spell.summary: 1 point: when a spell forces saves, up to Cha modifier (min 1) chosen creatures automatically succeed.

sorcerer|opt|Metamagic|Distant Spell.name: Distant Spell
sorcerer|opt|Metamagic|Distant Spell.summary: 1 point: double a range of 5 ft. or more, or make a touch spell's range 30 ft.

sorcerer|opt|Metamagic|Empowered Spell.name: Empowered Spell
sorcerer|opt|Metamagic|Empowered Spell.summary: 1 point: reroll up to Cha modifier (min 1) damage dice and keep the new results; can be combined with another Metamagic option.

sorcerer|opt|Metamagic|Extended Spell.name: Extended Spell
sorcerer|opt|Metamagic|Extended Spell.summary: 1 point: double a duration of 1 minute or longer, capped at 24 hours.

sorcerer|opt|Metamagic|Heightened Spell.name: Heightened Spell
sorcerer|opt|Metamagic|Heightened Spell.summary: 3 points: one target has disadvantage on its first save against the spell.

sorcerer|opt|Metamagic|Quickened Spell.name: Quickened Spell
sorcerer|opt|Metamagic|Quickened Spell.summary: 2 points: a spell with a 1-action casting time is cast as a bonus action instead.

sorcerer|opt|Metamagic|Subtle Spell.name: Subtle Spell
sorcerer|opt|Metamagic|Subtle Spell.summary: 1 point: cast without verbal or somatic components.

sorcerer|opt|Metamagic|Twinned Spell.name: Twinned Spell
sorcerer|opt|Metamagic|Twinned Spell.summary: Points equal to spell level (1 for a cantrip): a single-target, non-self spell also targets a second creature in range.

sorcerer|opt|Font of Magic|Convert slot.name: Convert slot to points
sorcerer|opt|Font of Magic|Convert slot.summary: Bonus action: expend a spell slot to gain sorcery points equal to its level.

warlock||Otherworldly Patron.name: Otherworldly Patron
warlock||Otherworldly Patron.summary: Choose a patron (Archfey, Fiend, or Great Old One); it grants features at 1st, 6th, 10th, and 14th level and an expanded spell list.

warlock||Pact Magic.name: Pact Magic
warlock||Pact Magic.summary: Charisma-based casting from the warlock list. Few slots, all cast at the table's Slot Level; every slot returns on a short or long rest. Spells known can be swapped on level-up; arcane focus allowed.

warlock||Eldritch Invocations.name: Eldritch Invocations
warlock||Eldritch Invocations.summary: Learn two invocations at 2nd level, more per the Invocations Known column; on each warlock level-up one known invocation may be replaced with another you qualify for.

warlock||Pact Boon.name: Pact Boon
warlock||Pact Boon.summary: Your patron grants one boon of your choice: Pact of the Chain, Pact of the Blade, or Pact of the Tome.

warlock||Ability Score Improvement.name: Ability Score Improvement
warlock||Ability Score Improvement.summary: At 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th, and 19th level raise one ability by 2 or two abilities by 1 (max 20).

warlock||Mystic Arcanum (6th level).name: Mystic Arcanum (6th level)
warlock||Mystic Arcanum (6th level).summary: Pick one 6th-level warlock spell as an arcanum; cast it once without using a spell slot, regaining the use on a long rest. Granted first at 11th level.

warlock||Mystic Arcanum (7th level).name: Mystic Arcanum (7th level)
warlock||Mystic Arcanum (7th level).summary: Pick one 7th-level warlock spell as an arcanum; cast it once without using a spell slot, regaining the use on a long rest.

warlock||Mystic Arcanum (8th level).name: Mystic Arcanum (8th level)
warlock||Mystic Arcanum (8th level).summary: Pick one 8th-level warlock spell as an arcanum; cast it once without using a spell slot, regaining the use on a long rest.

warlock||Mystic Arcanum (9th level).name: Mystic Arcanum (9th level)
warlock||Mystic Arcanum (9th level).summary: Pick one 9th-level warlock spell as an arcanum; cast it once without using a spell slot, regaining the use on a long rest.

warlock||Eldritch Master.name: Eldritch Master
warlock||Eldritch Master.summary: Spend 1 minute pleading with your patron to recover every expended Pact Magic slot; usable once per long rest.

warlock|fiend|Expanded Spell List.name: Expanded Spell List
warlock|fiend|Expanded Spell List.summary: The Fiend adds its expanded spells (see spells) to the warlock list for you when you learn warlock spells.

warlock|fiend|Dark One's Blessing.name: Dark One's Blessing
warlock|fiend|Dark One's Blessing.summary: When you drop a hostile creature to 0 HP, gain temporary HP equal to Charisma modifier + warlock level (minimum 1).

warlock|fiend|Dark One's Own Luck.name: Dark One's Own Luck
warlock|fiend|Dark One's Own Luck.summary: Add a d10 to an ability check or saving throw after seeing the roll but before its effects apply.

warlock|fiend|Fiendish Resilience.name: Fiendish Resilience
warlock|fiend|Fiendish Resilience.summary: After a short or long rest pick a damage type to resist until you pick another; magical and silvered weapon damage bypasses it.

warlock|fiend|Hurl Through Hell.name: Hurl Through Hell
warlock|fiend|Hurl Through Hell.summary: On a hit, banish the target through the lower planes until the end of your next turn; when it returns, a non-fiend takes 10d10 psychic damage.

warlock|archfey|Expanded Spell List.name: Expanded Spell List
warlock|archfey|Expanded Spell List.summary: The Archfey adds its expanded spells (see spells) to the warlock list for you when you learn warlock spells.

warlock|archfey|Fey Presence.name: Fey Presence
warlock|archfey|Fey Presence.summary: Action: every creature in a 10-foot cube from you makes a Wisdom save vs your spell DC or is charmed or frightened (your pick) until the end of your next turn.

warlock|archfey|Misty Escape.name: Misty Escape
warlock|archfey|Misty Escape.summary: Reaction when you take damage: become invisible and teleport up to 60 feet to a visible spot; invisibility lasts until your next turn starts or you attack or cast.

warlock|archfey|Beguiling Defenses.name: Beguiling Defenses
warlock|archfey|Beguiling Defenses.summary: Immune to being charmed; when someone tries to charm you, your reaction can force a Wisdom save or that creature is charmed by you for 1 minute or until damaged.

warlock|archfey|Dark Delirium.name: Dark Delirium
warlock|archfey|Dark Delirium.summary: Action: a creature within 60 feet makes a Wisdom save or is charmed or frightened for up to 1 minute (concentration), lost in an illusory realm; ends if it takes damage.

warlock|great-old-one|Expanded Spell Lis.name: Expanded Spell List
warlock|great-old-one|Expanded Spell Lis.summary: The Great Old One adds its expanded spells (see spells) to the warlock list for you when you learn warlock spells.

warlock|great-old-one|Awakened Mind.name: Awakened Mind
warlock|great-old-one|Awakened Mind.summary: Speak telepathically with any creature within 30 feet that knows at least one language, no shared language required.

warlock|great-old-one|Entropic Ward.name: Entropic Ward
warlock|great-old-one|Entropic Ward.summary: Reaction: impose disadvantage on an attack roll against you; if it misses, you have advantage on your next attack against that creature before the end of your next turn.

warlock|great-old-one|Thought Shield.name: Thought Shield
warlock|great-old-one|Thought Shield.summary: Your mind can't be read unless you allow it; resistance to psychic damage, and creatures that deal psychic damage to you take the same amount.

warlock|great-old-one|Create Thrall.name: Create Thrall
warlock|great-old-one|Create Thrall.summary: Action: touch an incapacitated humanoid to charm it until remove curse, the charm ends, or you use this again; you can talk to it telepathically on the same plane.

warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Agonizi.name: Agonizing Blast
