warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Agonizi.summary: Add your Charisma modifier to the damage of each eldritch blast hit.

warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Armor o.name: Armor of Shadows
warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Armor o.summary: Cast mage armor on yourself at will with no slot or material components.

warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Ascenda.name: Ascendant Step
warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Ascenda.summary: Cast levitate on yourself at will with no slot or material components.

warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Beast S.name: Beast Speech
warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Beast S.summary: Cast speak with animals at will without a spell slot.

warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Beguili.name: Beguiling Influence
warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Beguili.summary: Gain proficiency in Deception and Persuasion.

warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Bewitch.name: Bewitching Whispers
warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Bewitch.summary: Cast compulsion once with a warlock slot; regain on a long rest.

warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Book of.name: Book of Ancient Secrets
warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Book of.summary: Add two 1st-level ritual spells from any class to your Book of Shadows and cast them as rituals; copy more rituals up to half your warlock level (rounded up) at 2 hours and 50 gp per spell level. Also cast known warlock rituals as rituals.

warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Chains.name: Chains of Carceri
warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Chains.summary: Cast hold monster at will on a celestial, fiend, or elemental with no slot or material components; once per creature per long rest.

warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Devil's.name: Devil's Sight
warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Devil's.summary: See normally in magical and nonmagical darkness out to 120 feet.

warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Dreadfu.name: Dreadful Word
warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Dreadfu.summary: Cast confusion once with a warlock slot; regain on a long rest.

warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Eldritc.name: Eldritch Sight
warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Eldritc.summary: Cast detect magic at will without a spell slot.

warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Fiendis.name: Fiendish Vigor
warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Fiendis.summary: Cast false life on yourself at will as a 1st-level spell, with no slot or material components.

warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Gaze of.name: Gaze of Two Minds
warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Gaze of.summary: Action: touch a willing humanoid and use its senses until the end of your next turn (extendable each turn with an action while on the same plane); you are blind and deaf to your own surroundings meanwhile.

warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Lifedri.name: Lifedrinker
warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Lifedri.summary: Pact weapon hits deal extra necrotic damage equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1).

warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Mask of.name: Mask of Many Faces
warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Mask of.summary: Cast disguise self at will without a spell slot.

warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Master.name: Master of Myriad Forms
warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Master.summary: Cast alter self at will without a spell slot.

warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Minions.name: Minions of Chaos
warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Minions.summary: Cast conjure elemental once with a warlock slot; regain on a long rest.

warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Mire th.name: Mire the Mind
warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Mire th.summary: Cast slow once with a warlock slot; regain on a long rest.

warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Misty V.name: Misty Visions
warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Misty V.summary: Cast silent image at will with no slot or material components.

warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|One wit.name: One with Shadows
warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|One wit.summary: In dim light or darkness, use an action to turn invisible until you move or take an action or reaction.

warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Otherwo.name: Otherworldly Leap
warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Otherwo.summary: Cast jump on yourself at will with no slot or material components.

warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Repelli.name: Repelling Blast
warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Repelli.summary: Each eldritch blast hit can shove the target up to 10 feet straight away from you.

warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Sculpto.name: Sculptor of Flesh
warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Sculpto.summary: Cast polymorph once with a warlock slot; regain on a long rest.

warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Sign of.name: Sign of Ill Omen
warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Sign of.summary: Cast bestow curse once with a warlock slot; regain on a long rest.

warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Thief o.name: Thief of Five Fates
warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Thief o.summary: Cast bane once with a warlock slot; regain on a long rest.

warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Thirsti.name: Thirsting Blade
warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Thirsti.summary: Attack twice with your pact weapon when you take the Attack action.

warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Visions.name: Visions of Distant Realms
warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Visions.summary: Cast arcane eye at will without a spell slot.

warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Voice o.name: Voice of the Chain Master
warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Voice o.summary: Communicate telepathically with your familiar, perceive through its senses, and speak through it in your own voice while on the same plane.

warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Whisper.name: Whispers of the Grave
warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Whisper.summary: Cast speak with dead at will without a spell slot.

warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Witch S.name: Witch Sight
warlock|opt|Eldritch Invocations|Witch S.summary: See the true form of shapechangers and of creatures hidden by illusion or transmutation magic within 30 feet and in line of sight.

warlock|opt|Pact Boon|Pact of the Chain.name: Pact of the Chain
warlock|opt|Pact Boon|Pact of the Chain.summary: Learn find familiar, cast as a ritual and not counted against spells known; familiar may also be an imp, pseudodragon, quasit, or sprite, and can make one attack when you forgo one of yours during the Attack action.

warlock|opt|Pact Boon|Pact of the Blade.name: Pact of the Blade
warlock|opt|Pact Boon|Pact of the Blade.summary: Action: summon a melee pact weapon of any form, proficient and magical for overcoming resistance. Can bind one magic weapon (non-artifact, non-sentient) via a 1-hour ritual to summon instead. Vanishes if more than 5 ft away for 1 minute.

warlock|opt|Pact Boon|Pact of the Tome.name: Pact of the Tome
warlock|opt|Pact Boon|Pact of the Tome.summary: Receive a Book of Shadows holding three cantrips from any class list, castable at will while you carry it and not counted against cantrips known; a lost book can be replaced with a 1-hour ceremony.

wizard||Spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
wizard||Spellcasting.summary: Intelligence-based prepared casting from a spellbook (starts with six 1st-level spells, +2 free spells per level). Prepare Int mod + wizard level spells after a long rest; ritual-cast spellbook rituals unprepared; arcane focus allowed.

wizard||Arcane Recovery.name: Arcane Recovery
wizard||Arcane Recovery.summary: Once per day after a short rest, recover expended slots whose combined level is at most half your wizard level rounded up; none may be 6th level or higher.

wizard||Arcane Tradition.name: Arcane Tradition
wizard||Arcane Tradition.summary: Choose one of eight schools (Abjuration, Conjuration, Divination, Enchantment, Evocation, Illusion, Necromancy, Transmutation); it grants features at 2nd, 6th, 10th, and 14th level.

wizard||Ability Score Improvement.name: Ability Score Improvement
wizard||Ability Score Improvement.summary: At 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th, and 19th level raise one ability by 2 or two abilities by 1 (max 20).

wizard||Spell Mastery.name: Spell Mastery
wizard||Spell Mastery.summary: Pick one 1st-level and one 2nd-level spellbook spell; while prepared, cast them at their base level without a slot. Swap choices with 8 hours of study.

wizard||Signature Spell.name: Signature Spell
wizard||Signature Spell.summary: (Section heading prints 'Signature Spells'.) Two chosen 3rd-level spellbook spells are always prepared, don't count against prepared spells, and each can be cast once at 3rd level without a slot per short or long rest.

wizard|res|signature-spells.name: Signature spell free casts (one per spell)

wizard|evocation|Evocation Savant.name: Evocation Savant
wizard|evocation|Evocation Savant.summary: Copying evocation spells into your spellbook costs half the usual gold and time.

wizard|evocation|Sculpt Spells.name: Sculpt Spells
wizard|evocation|Sculpt Spells.summary: When casting an evocation spell, choose up to 1 + spell level visible creatures; they automatically succeed on its saves and take no damage where a save would halve it.

wizard|evocation|Potent Cantrip.name: Potent Cantrip
wizard|evocation|Potent Cantrip.summary: Creatures that succeed on a save against your cantrip still take half its damage, without other effects.

wizard|evocation|Empowered Evocation.name: Empowered Evocation
wizard|evocation|Empowered Evocation.summary: Add your Intelligence modifier to the damage roll of wizard evocation spells you cast.

wizard|evocation|Overchannel.name: Overchannel
wizard|evocation|Overchannel.summary: Deal maximum damage with a damaging wizard spell of 5th level or lower. Free once per long rest; each further use before resting deals you 2d12 necrotic per spell level, +1d12 per level each time, ignoring resistance and immunity.

wizard|abjuration|Abjuration Savant.name: Abjuration Savant
wizard|abjuration|Abjuration Savant.summary: Copying abjuration spells into your spellbook costs half the usual gold and time.

wizard|abjuration|Arcane Ward.name: Arcane Ward
wizard|abjuration|Arcane Ward.summary: Casting a 1st+ level abjuration spell can create a ward on you (once per long rest) with HP 2 x wizard level + Int mod that absorbs damage to you; later abjuration spells restore 2 x spell level HP to it.

wizard|abjuration|Projected Ward.name: Projected Ward
wizard|abjuration|Projected Ward.summary: Reaction: when a creature you can see within 30 feet takes damage, your Arcane Ward absorbs it instead; overflow goes to that creature.

wizard|abjuration|Improved Abjuration.name: Improved Abjuration
wizard|abjuration|Improved Abjuration.summary: Add your proficiency bonus to ability checks made as part of casting abjuration spells (e.g. counterspell, dispel magic).

wizard|abjuration|Spell Resistance.name: Spell Resistance
wizard|abjuration|Spell Resistance.summary: Advantage on saving throws against spells and resistance to spell damage.

wizard|conjuration|Conjuration Savant.name: Conjuration Savant
wizard|conjuration|Conjuration Savant.summary: Copying conjuration spells into your spellbook costs half the usual gold and time.

wizard|conjuration|Minor Conjuration.name: Minor Conjuration
wizard|conjuration|Minor Conjuration.summary: Action: create a nonmagical-looking, faintly glowing object (max 3 ft per side, 10 lb) within 10 feet for 1 hour; ends early if damaged or reused.

wizard|conjuration|Benign Transposition.name: Benign Transposition
wizard|conjuration|Benign Transposition.summary: Action: teleport up to 30 feet, or swap places with a willing Small/Medium creature. Recharges on a long rest or when you cast a 1st+ level conjuration spell.

wizard|conjuration|Focused Conjuration.name: Focused Conjuration
wizard|conjuration|Focused Conjuration.summary: Taking damage can't break your concentration on a conjuration spell.

wizard|conjuration|Durable Summons.name: Durable Summons
wizard|conjuration|Durable Summons.summary: Creatures you summon or create with conjuration spells gain 30 temporary hit points.

wizard|divination|Divination Savant.name: Divination Savant
wizard|divination|Divination Savant.summary: Copying divination spells into your spellbook costs half the usual gold and time.

wizard|divination|Portent.name: Portent
wizard|divination|Portent.summary: After each long rest roll two d20s and keep them; once per turn replace an attack roll, save, or ability check by you or a visible creature with one, decided before rolling. Unused rolls are lost on the next long rest.

wizard|divination|Expert Divination.name: Expert Divination
wizard|divination|Expert Divination.summary: Casting a divination spell of 2nd level or higher with a slot regains one expended slot of a lower level (5th level max).

wizard|divination|The Third Eye.name: The Third Eye
wizard|divination|The Third Eye.summary: Action: gain one chosen sense benefit until incapacitated or you take a short or long rest; reusable after a rest.

wizard|divination|Greater Portent.name: Greater Portent
wizard|divination|Greater Portent.summary: Portent gives you three d20s per long rest instead of two.

wizard|opt|The Third Eye|Ethereal Sight.name: Ethereal Sight
wizard|opt|The Third Eye|Ethereal Sight.summary: See into the Ethereal Plane within 60 feet.

wizard|opt|The Third Eye|See Invisibilit.name: See Invisibility
wizard|opt|The Third Eye|See Invisibilit.summary: See invisible creatures and objects within 10 feet in line of sight.

wizard|enchantment|Enchantment Savant.name: Enchantment Savant
wizard|enchantment|Enchantment Savant.summary: Copying enchantment spells into your spellbook costs half the usual gold and time.

wizard|enchantment|Hypnotic Gaze.name: Hypnotic Gaze
wizard|enchantment|Hypnotic Gaze.summary: Action: a creature within 5 feet that can see or hear you makes a Wisdom save or is charmed, speed 0 and incapacitated until your next turn ends; sustain with an action each turn. On a save or end, can't target it again until a long rest.

wizard|enchantment|Instinctive Charm.name: Instinctive Charm
wizard|enchantment|Instinctive Charm.summary: Reaction: an attacker within 30 feet makes a Wisdom save or must redirect its attack to the nearest other creature in range; on a success you can't use this on it until a long rest.

wizard|enchantment|Split Enchantment.name: Split Enchantment
wizard|enchantment|Split Enchantment.summary: A 1st+ level enchantment spell that targets only one creature can target a second creature.

wizard|enchantment|Alter Memories.name: Alter Memories
wizard|enchantment|Alter Memories.summary: When you charm creatures with an enchantment spell, one stays unaware it was charmed; before the spell ends, an action can make it lose up to 1 + Cha mod hours of memory on a failed Int save.

wizard|illusion|Illusion Savant.name: Illusion Savant
wizard|illusion|Illusion Savant.summary: Copying illusion spells into your spellbook costs half the usual gold and time.

wizard|illusion|Improved Minor Illusion.name: Improved Minor Illusion
wizard|illusion|Improved Minor Illusion.summary: Learn minor illusion (or another wizard cantrip if known) without it counting against cantrips known; your minor illusion can make both a sound and an image.

wizard|illusion|Malleable Illusions.name: Malleable Illusions
wizard|illusion|Malleable Illusions.summary: Action: reshape an active illusion spell of yours with duration 1 minute or longer, within that spell's parameters, while you can see it.

wizard|illusion|Illusory Self.name: Illusory Self
wizard|illusion|Illusory Self.summary: Reaction to an attack roll against you: an illusory double makes the attack miss automatically.

wizard|illusion|Illusory Reality.name: Illusory Reality
wizard|illusion|Illusory Reality.summary: While a 1st+ level illusion spell lasts, bonus action: make one inanimate, nonmagical object in it real for 1 minute; it can't deal damage or directly harm anyone.

wizard|necromancy|Necromancy Savant.name: Necromancy Savant
wizard|necromancy|Necromancy Savant.summary: Copying necromancy spells into your spellbook costs half the usual gold and time.

wizard|necromancy|Grim Harvest.name: Grim Harvest
wizard|necromancy|Grim Harvest.summary: Once per turn, killing creatures with a 1st+ level spell heals you 2 x spell level (3 x for necromancy spells); not for constructs or undead.

wizard|necromancy|Undead Thralls.name: Undead Thralls
wizard|necromancy|Undead Thralls.summary: Gain animate dead in your spellbook; it raises one extra corpse. Undead you create with necromancy get extra max HP equal to your wizard level and add your proficiency bonus to weapon damage.

wizard|necromancy|Inured to Undeath.name: Inured to Undeath
wizard|necromancy|Inured to Undeath.summary: Resistance to necrotic damage, and your hit point maximum can't be reduced.

wizard|necromancy|Command Undead.name: Command Undead
wizard|necromancy|Command Undead.summary: Action: an undead within 60 feet makes a Charisma save or becomes friendly and obeys you until you use this again; smart undead (Int 8+) get advantage, Int 12+ can re-save each turn. A success makes it permanently immune to this feature.

wizard|transmutation|Transmutation Savan.name: Transmutation Savant
wizard|transmutation|Transmutation Savan.summary: Copying transmutation spells into your spellbook costs half the usual gold and time.

wizard|transmutation|Minor Alchemy.name: Minor Alchemy
wizard|transmutation|Minor Alchemy.summary: Spend 10 minutes per cubic foot (up to 1 cubic foot) to turn wood, stone (not gems), iron, copper, or silver into another of those for 1 hour or until your concentration breaks.

wizard|transmutation|Transmuter's Stone.name: Transmuter's Stone
wizard|transmutation|Transmuter's Stone.summary: Spend 8 hours to craft a stone granting its bearer one chosen benefit; casting a 1st+ level transmutation spell lets you change the benefit. Making a new stone ends the old one.

wizard|transmutation|Shapechanger.name: Shapechanger
wizard|transmutation|Shapechanger.summary: Add polymorph to your spellbook; once per short or long rest cast it without a slot on yourself only, becoming a beast of CR 1 or lower.

wizard|transmutation|Master Transmuter.name: Master Transmuter
wizard|transmutation|Master Transmuter.summary: Action: destroy your transmuter's stone to produce one major effect; the stone can't be remade until a long rest.

wizard|opt|Transmuter's Stone|Energy res.name: Energy resistance
wizard|opt|Transmuter's Stone|Energy res.summary: Resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage (chosen each time this benefit is picked).

wizard|opt|Master Transmuter|Major Trans.name: Major Transformation
wizard|opt|Master Transmuter|Major Trans.summary: Over 10 minutes, turn a nonmagical object up to a 5-foot cube into another nonmagical object of similar size and mass and equal or lower value.

wizard|opt|Master Transmuter|Panacea.name: Panacea
wizard|opt|Master Transmuter|Panacea.summary: Touched creature is cured of all curses, diseases, and poisons and regains all hit points.

wizard|opt|Master Transmuter|Restore Lif.name: Restore Life
wizard|opt|Master Transmuter|Restore Lif.summary: Cast raise dead by touch with no slot and no need to have it in your spellbook.

wizard|opt|Master Transmuter|Restore You.name: Restore Youth
wizard|opt|Master Transmuter|Restore You.summary: A willing touched creature's apparent age drops by 3d10 years (minimum 13); lifespan is not extended.
